text:
samir_p: Quick follow-up from the latest postmortem stack  want to consolidate recurring network/LB/DNS behaviors into actionable owners. Short thread: patterns, owners, and short timelines.

zoe_l: Sounds good. Which fingerprints are we hunting?

samir_p: Two main fingerprints: 1) edge session teardowns during short cross-region bursts (clients see CONNECT_RESET after 10-30s) 2) resolver domino where a control-plane failover causes a handful of resolvers to spike and cascade retries.

mike_h: For the session teardowns I saw a consistent symptom: backend pod restarts + proxy half-close with no 1xx/200 in access logs. Seems related to upstream connection re-use + abrupt connection reuse failure.

ranjit_s: Linking our postmortem notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-edge-burst-teardown.pdf  has tcpdump snippets and proxy traces.

ops-bot: Attached metrics: https://dashboards.internal/boards/edge-sess?range=48h  connection_reset_rate, proxy_reuse_errs, resolver_latency_p95. (auto-upload)

zoe_l: Proposal for owners/timelines:
- edge session teardowns: owner mike_h, 10 business days to prototype connection lifecycle changes + safe canary.
- resolver domino: owner ranjit_s, 3 weeks to implement resolver scoring + staggered control-plane drain, then 1 week validation.

samir_p: Also add a third quick mitigation: temporary per-route connection caps to limit fanout until root cause fixed. Owner: zoe_l to prototype in 1w.

mike_h: I'll start an RFC for connection lifecycle changes. Key idea: ensure in-flight streams gracefully failover to a new backend when we detect upstream reuse errors, and add a short jitter before client-side retries.

ranjit_s: For resolver domino, plan is: health-score per resolver, ramped failover with exponential backoff per resolver, and a small chaos test in staging to reproduce the cascade. I can run the chaos test if someone helps wire the mesh.

zoe_l: I'll help wire the staging mesh. Also let's define metrics to watch in canary: conn_reset_rate, upstream_reuse_error_rate, resolver_swap_error_ratio, client_retry_amplification.

ops-bot: Playbooks referenced: https://playbooks.internal/edge-conn-cap, https://playbooks.internal/dns-failover-staged (auto-link).

samir_p: Meeting cadence suggestion: 30m sync Tuesdays for 3 weeks, then review. Who's in?

mike_h: In.

zoe_l: In.

ranjit_s: In for first two.

samir_p: Action items: 
- mike_h: RFC + prototype for connection lifecycle fallback + canary plan  due in 10 business days.
- ranjit_s: resolver scoring design + staging chaos test + validation plan  due in 3w.
- zoe_l: per-route connection cap prototype + staging wiring  due in 1w.
- samir_p: create trendboard card, attach dashboards, set alerts for conn_reset_rate threshold  today.

mike_h: One note: avoid broad TLS stack changes during the prototype. We'll focus on proxy behavior and retry jitter.

zoe_l: Also we should add a small synthetic client that simulates mobile retry patterns to ensure we don't create worse amplification. I'll add it to the design doc.

ranjit_s: I'll add expected rollback criteria (no improvement in conn_reset_rate after canary + increased client retries) to the plan.

samir_p: Great. I'll post a brief summary to #sre once the RFC and design links exist. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
